constructor.details: Initialize the packed config slot and seed the authorized signer set.      An empty initialSigners array is intentionally permitted to support two-step      deployment flows where signers are added via governance after deployment.      If initialSigners is empty, the inheritor MUST expose _setSignerStatus through      an access-controlled public setter; otherwise the contract will be permanently      unable to verify any oracle payload.

params.initialSigners: Initial set of authorized signer addresses (empty array is valid)
params.maxDelay: Staleness tolerance in seconds (must be non-zero)
params.maxFutureDrift: Future drift tolerance in seconds (zero is a valid strict policy)

returns._0: The staleness tolerance threshold in seconds
The future drift tolerance threshold in seconds
The maximum number of packages allowed in a single update
True if the address is authorized to sign price data

getMaxDelay().notice: Return the current maxDelay in seconds

getMaxFutureDrift().notice: Return the current maxFutureDrift in seconds

isAuthorizedSigner(address).notice: Check whether an address is an authorized signer
